meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Python 通过一套统一接口访问约 40 个生物信息学数据库和服务:检索蛋白序列与注释、代谢通路、化合物信息,并在数据库之间转换标识符。
howto.when: 当你需要在一条流程里查询多个数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),或做跨库标识符映射时触发。原文注明:单库快速查询用 gget,序列/文件操作用 biopython。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use Python to query roughly 40 bioinformatics services through one API: fetch protein sequences and annotations, pathways, and compound records, and convert identifiers between databases.
howto.when_en: Use when you query several databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) in one workflow or map IDs across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget.
